The payee's taxpayer identification number and certification for information reporting

Expense only intangible assets with no physical component ever

Accrual entries are required for all inventory businesses without exception

Personal gifts between family members with no business purpose

A nondeductible personal expense in every case

The entity is a sole proprietorship by definition alone
